+---
+## What
+One catalog for all error codes and their messages. The basis is plan.md §4.4.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL/Errors.swift`: one Swift type for each code: `INVALID_VARIABLES`, `NOT_FOUND`, `AMBIGUOUS_ID`, `ACTOR_NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE_ID`, `COLUMN_NOT_EMPTY`, `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`, `TAG_RENAME_CYCLE`, `NOTHING_TO_UNDO`, `UNDO_CONFLICT`, `INVALID_FILTER`, `INVALID_TAG_NAME`, `INVALID_SLUG`, `INVALID_ORDINAL`, `BOARD_BUSY`, `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL`.
+- Each error has `message`, `path`, and `extensions.code`. Each message tells the model how to correct the call (for example `AMBIGUOUS_ID` lists the matching short ids; `NOT_FOUND` for a board lists the search roots).
+- Change the existing throw sites of the mutation and filter code to use this catalog.
+- The tool never throws for a GraphQL error; it returns the response JSON.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each code has one test that makes it happen through `execute`.
+- [ ] Each message has a correction (a test checks that each message has a suggestion or an example).
+- [ ] A failed field gives `data` for the other fields and one item in `errors`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/GraphQL/ErrorCatalogTests.swift`: one test for each code (codes for later features, such as `UNDO_CONFLICT` and `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL`, are tested in their own tasks; this task tests the message format for them).
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ErrorCatalogTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: wballard
+  id: 01m4cerk5zmam8prhnzemddcm6
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - A resolver error goes through GraphQLSwift `locatedError`. It wraps the `KanbanError` in a `GraphQLError` with `message: String(describing: error)` and empty `extensions`. Thus today the response message is the Swift case text (for example `notFound(type: ...)`), not `KanbanError.message`, and there is no `extensions.code`.
+    - If a resolver throws a `GraphQLError` directly, `locatedError` returns it as is, with NO path. Thus the fix must not throw a GraphQLError from a resolver. The fix maps each error of the result after execution: when `originalError` is a `KanbanError`, it sets the message and `extensions.code` and keeps the path, the locations, and `originalError`.
+    - Place of the fix: `API.result(of:variables:operationName:context:)` in Schema.swift, after `RewrittenDocument.callerResult(from:)`, so that `PublicSchema.respond` (and thus `KanbanGraph.execute`) gives the code. `PublicSchema.execute` (used by tests that read `originalError`) does not change.
+    - All public mutation fields already return optionals, so a failed field is null and the other fields keep their data.
+    - Ambiguous prefix through execute: two tasks that one call adds share the timestamp part of their ULIDs (FixedULIDSource), and the fixture task has a different timestamp.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-08T00:31:41.759347+00:00
